race.comment: GO ASK ALICE (7) ran a much better race when finishing third here 3 weeks ago in her first run around this circuit. She still does things wrong in the running, and if she can put it all together, she is capable of winning a race like this. OFFA'S DYKE (2) put in a couple of sound runs here last season, and will be a lot stronger this time in work. He is drawn to do no work early on from the pole position, and is worth including in all top 4 combos. FOMENTER (1) has been a beaten favourite in both of his starts to date, and has since changed trainers. He will find the company here more to his liking, and it is only a wide draw that is preventing him from being the top pick in this. TREVIDI (4) has been having no luck in his runs after starting from a pair of very wide gates, and those efforts should be ignored. He has a far more favourable draw this time, and is worth another chance.
